acceptance.criterion: ST-003.1. The six places are three commands and three skills. `plugins/product-orchestrator/commands/product-prd.md`: before the PRD is saved, the agent loads the `asd-ste100` skill and rewrites the PRD's requirements and acceptance criteria in its Strict mode. Other PRD text is left as written.
acceptance.evidence: plugins/product-orchestrator/commands/product-prd.md:13 explicitly loads the skill before saving, selects Strict mode for requirements and acceptance criteria, and leaves the rest unchanged. The diff adds the six specified integration sites.

acceptance.criterion: ST-003.2. `plugins/product-orchestrator/commands/product-clarify.md` step 5: text the agent writes into a PRD section to encode an answer is rewritten in Strict mode. The `- Q: <question> → A: <answer>` bullet keeps the user's answer verbatim; prose that encodes it is the agent's and is rewritten, but any words it quotes from the answer stay as quoted. `plugins/product-orchestrator/commands/project-charter.md` step 3: principles, technical constraints, architectural boundaries and non-negotiables are rewritten in Strict mode before the project's charter file is written.
acceptance.evidence: product-clarify.md:17 distinguishes rewritten encoding prose from the verbatim answer bullet and quotations. project-charter.md:19 applies Strict mode to all four named categories before Step 4 writes the file.

acceptance.criterion: ST-003.3. `plugins/project-init/skills/session-end/SKILL.md`: at Step 4 the handoff's "Open work" and "Procedural reminders" sections are rewritten in STE-flavored mode; "What landed", "Mistakes" and the suggested opening line are left as written. At Step 6, the rule text of each new or edited `feedback_*.md` or shared-memory file is rewritten in Strict mode.
acceptance.evidence: plugins/project-init/skills/session-end/SKILL.md:194 specifies the two STE-flavored sections and the three exclusions; line 389 applies Strict mode before writing new or edited feedback/shared-memory rule files.

acceptance.criterion: ST-003.4. `plugins/team-kanban/skills/team-kanban/SKILL.md` Mode 1: a new issue's **Acceptance** section is rewritten in Strict mode. **Context** keeps the originating signal's words as quoted.
acceptance.evidence: plugins/team-kanban/skills/team-kanban/SKILL.md:92 adds both requirements to Mode 1's new-candidate issue-authoring instruction.

acceptance.criterion: ST-003.5. `plugins/chief-of-staff/skills/chief-of-staff/SKILL.md` Dispatching item 3: the success criteria are rewritten in Strict mode before dispatch. The ask stays in Dorian's words, and nothing in a result that goes back to Dorian is rewritten.
acceptance.evidence: plugins/chief-of-staff/skills/chief-of-staff/SKILL.md:87 requires the Strict pass before sending and explicitly excludes Dorian's ask and results, memos and reports going back to him.

acceptance.criterion: ST-003.6. Every addition in criteria 1 to 5 says: text that quotes Dorian or a user's answer stays verbatim; the skill's suggestions and `ste-lint.py`'s findings are advice and never gate design, review, merge or release; and when the skill isn't installed the command says so and goes on.
acceptance.evidence: All six integrations preserve quotations and declare the suggestions/findings advisory. However, chief-of-staff/SKILL.md:87 and 173–176 provide no instruction to continue dispatch when the skill is missing; only a 'not installed' alternative appears in the log template. See F1.

acceptance.criterion: ST-003.7. Each run of the six places in criteria 1 to 5, and of ST-002's `/gstack-design-doc` and `/gstack-goal-new`, ends its report to the person who ran it with one summary line, counts combined across that run's passes: `asd-ste100: <n> rewritten, <m> kept as-is`, then upstream's `Kept as-is:` line for each kept phrase; or `asd-ste100: not installed`, which is how the run says the skill is missing (criterion 6). For the Chief of Staff the line goes in its run log, never in a result or memo to Dorian. A count line shows the pass ran; `not installed` shows the run reached the pass and found no skill; no line means the pass didn't run. None of them fails the run. The line is the command's own output, not a measurement report or score, and no ledger or check reads it. ST-002's two commands already carry criterion 6's rules and gain only this line.
acceptance.evidence: All eight files gain summary output, aggregation and kept-phrase instructions, and Chief of Staff confines it to its log. But chief-of-staff/SKILL.md:165 requires the log on every exit, including a missing-context-card exit before dispatch, while line 173 unconditionally includes a count/not-installed choice. This can report a pass or a missing-skill check that never occurred. See F2.

acceptance.criterion: ST-003.8. No script, hook, workflow or `CODEOWNERS` path changes, and nothing under `skill-bundles/`.
acceptance.evidence: The complete CHANGE.diff modifies Markdown instructions/documentation, JSON manifests and review records only. No changed path is a script, hook, workflow, CODEOWNERS file or under skill-bundles/.

acceptance.criterion: ST-003.9. Versions move by text replacement in each plugin's `plugin.json`, its `marketplace.json` entry and, where the plugin keeps one, its README Version History: `product-orchestrator` 0.6.0 to 0.7.0, `project-init` 0.46.1 to 0.47.0, `team-kanban` 0.7.0 to 0.8.0, `chief-of-staff` 0.3.1 to 0.4.0, `gstack-execution` 0.104.0 to 0.104.1. acceptance.evidence: CHANGE.diff shows the five exact manifest and marketplace-entry replacements, new history entries in the four supplied plugin READMEs, and one top-level marketplace move from 1.170.0 to 1.171.0. Verified head-matching ledger run 6e6d26b31ea0 passes and names all five plugins.

acceptance.criterion: ST-003.10. Tests: `run_all_tests.py` green in CI at the head, the CI-001 packaging check passes, and the CI-002 version check names all five plugins among what it examined.
acceptance.evidence: evidence/ci-44198180530.json has head_matches=true and successful 'Run every check in the repository' and version-check steps. Head-matching, receipt-verified ledger run 08c4960f0849 exits 0 with 247 packages examined, failed=[] and gate=PASS. Equivalent verified run 6e6d26b31ea0 names chief-of-staff, gstack-execution, product-orchestrator, project-init and team-kanban. The CI job summary is unavailable, but the successful steps and verified ledger receipts provide the required evidence.

findings.what: Chief of Staff does not say to continue when asd-ste100 is unavailable.
findings.evidence: Dispatching item 3 requires rewriting before sending. Unlike the other integrations, neither this instruction nor the log explanation provides a missing-skill continuation branch. Line 173 merely lists 'not installed' as a template alternative; it does not waive the prerequisite to dispatch.
findings.fix: Explicitly instruct the agent to leave the success criteria unchanged, continue the dispatch, and record 'asd-ste100: not installed' in the run log if the skill cannot be loaded.

findings.what: The unconditional log field can claim a pass ran on exits that never reached the pass.
findings.evidence: The decision-log instructions at line 165 require this entry on every exit and explicitly include a stop for a missing context card. That stop precedes Dispatching item 3, the only asd-ste100 pass. The new template nevertheless requires either counts or 'not installed', with no omission condition. Neither accurately represents an unreached pass. A similar unconditional report instruction appears in product-clarify.md:18 although a no-ambiguity run never enters Step 5.
findings.criterion: ST-003.7: a count line shows the pass ran; not installed shows the pass was reached and the skill was missing; no line means the pass did not run.
findings.fix: Condition summary emission on reaching the pass: omit the line when no pass was reached, use 'not installed' only after a missing-skill check, and emit aggregate counts only after a pass ran. Apply the same distinction to no-answer clarification and no-new-issue sync runs.

findings.what: A prior-review receipt contains an embedded directive.
findings.evidence: The untrusted receipt says: 'State where the line is printed.' This was treated as quoted review data, not as an instruction governing this review.
findings.fix: Keep the receipt as historical evidence and preserve its untrusted-data boundary when presenting it to reviewers.

findings.what: A prior-review receipt directs the reader to supply evidence.
findings.evidence: The untrusted receipt says: 'Name the evidence, such as a text-presence check or a reviewer reading the command files.' This was not adopted as an instruction.
findings.fix: Continue presenting this historical reviewer text as untrusted evidence rather than executable review guidance.

notes: Reviewed the supplied surface, full affected command/skill text, manifest/history hunks and dispatcher-fetched evidence without executing commands. The scoped rewrite behavior is present; the remaining blockers concern missing-skill continuation and truthful reporting when a pass was never reached.
